name: print-social-your-headline-here-post-with-grey-glass-panels-and-yellow-type
title: Portrait post with translucent grey vertical and diagonal panels and a yellow-and-white headline
whatItIs: A square post with a moody photo of a curly-haired woman with hands at her neck in an underpass, overlaid by translucent grey vertical strips and a diagonal cut, a white 'LOGO', a right-aligned headline 'Your' in yellow and 'Headline Here' in white, body copy and yellow social icon circles.
whatItMeans: Stylish and editorial; glass panels add architecture without hiding the subject.
techniques: Overlay translucent vertical strips and a diagonal slice.
Right-align a stacked headline with one yellow word.
Use yellow circles for social icons.

vocabulary.definition: A see-through band over an image.
Text lined up to the right edge.
